criteria.uncertainty_note: Eight deterministic simulated perturbations are a small bounded suite, not independent real storms. Every case and all four subsets must pass guards and primary nonregression; at least four paired cases must individually improve by both 10 m3 and 10 percent, and the aggregate must improve by at least 80 m3 and 10 percent. No relaxed criteria after outcomes.

conclusion: The frozen candidate does not meet every predeclared criterion; inspect the complete case table and guard failures.
limitations: Fixed Theta benchmark and 8 simulated perturbations; no field calibration or general safety claim.
The heldout suite was executed once after candidate freeze; unfavorable and invalid cases are retained in the table.
All complete traces were independently checked during execution and retained in compressed case packets. Extra retention was authorized before outcomes without changing any criteria.
This is a fixed policy comparison. No algorithmic superiority is claimed without a complete equal-budget optimization baseline.

Phase 2 used causal-depth-history-feedback-v2 instead of the protocol's v1 identifier. A pre-execution clarification records isolated history of the same permitted observations; no transforms or acceptance criteria changed.

content.change: The v2 identifier names isolated per-run memory of current and past instances of the same permitted depth observations. It introduces no additional observation source.
permitted_information: Current possibly noisy or biased measured depths
Earlier instances of those same measured depths stored in isolated per-run state
Declared static model geometry and controller parameters
prohibited_information: Noise-free true simulator depth as a separate control input
Active fault catalog, timing, type or hidden status
Future observations, terminal metrics or heldout outcomes
invariant_requirements: Every reference and candidate run uses the same v2 experiment/context information-boundary identifier
Controller state is constructed empty inside every run_simulation invocation
Controller code receives only observations, static geometry, parameters and its isolated state
unchanged: All development and heldout acceptance thresholds
The fixed development pair and reference policy
content.chronology: This clarification is recorded after phase 2 controller development began but before any phase 2 heldout execution or outcome. It is a disclosed identifier deviation, not a revision of the frozen protocol bytes.
content.authorization: Root agent accepted this semantic treatment before phase 2 execution; genuine expansion of the observable set is not authorized by this clarification.
